thread:
emma: heads-up — acme-corp reporting bulk indexing failures when pushing embeddings to our vecdb. started ~yesterday after they switched model. error from indexer: '400 Bad Request: vector dimension mismatch (expected=1536 got=1024)'. they attached a few sample ids. @ryan can you triage?
ryan: on it. do we know which model they swapped to? any batching differences?
emma: they said they moved from rdx-embed-large (1536) -> community/fast-embed-lite (1024). requests are batched (up to 256 vectors/request). payloads show multiple dims mixed in same batch.
priya: that screams client pinning + autoscaling model swap. If some workers route to old model and some to new one during the rollout, batches could mix dims. also saw a spike in auth failures around the same time.
lucas: checked edge logs — there was a brief auth token rotation at 1715090000 for a customer-managed key; a handful of requests retried, causing small bursts. our rate limiter logged 429s for the indexer service right before the 400s.
ryan: grabbing indexer logs now. snippet: ```
2024-04-12T21:03:12Z indexer WARN batch_processor[req=abcd] batched_dims=[1536,1536,1024,1536] -> reject vector 3: dim=1024 expected=1536
2024-04-12T21:03:12Z indexer ERROR write failed id=acme-0123 err="dimension mismatch"
```
ryan: reproduction quick test: curl to /v1/embeddings with payload containing two vectors (one from each model) -> indexer rejects batch.
emma: customer is blocked for ~12k documents. they're asking if we can backfill with minimal downtime. billing is impacted — some inserts charged then rolled back.
priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) force routing to a single embedding model variant (1536) for acme-corp until we coordinate a migration; 2) add a temporary indexer transform to split heterogeneous batches into single-dim sub-batches (slower but unblocking); 3) accept new schema on vecdb and run a conversion/retention job to normalize dims.
lucas: Can we do (2) as a fast path? indexer change is low-risk and hotfixable. will increase token cost but should be quick.
ryan: I can push a small change to indexer: detect mixed-dim batch -> NACK original batch and re-split client-side, or auto-pad/truncate (but that changes semantics). prefer split-and-retry. prepping patch now.
vendor-sam: vecdb side: we currently enforce a single vector dimension per collection. we can create a new collection with dim=1024 and accept the 1024 vectors, then run a cross-collection join later, but search semantics differ. if you want an in-place migration we can accept a schema migration and convert existing vectors to 1024 via PCA/quantization, but that's heavy.
emma: customer asked about a quick rollback: can we route them back to rdx-embed-large?
priya: yes — add a routing override for their account to pin model rdx-embed-large (1536). That will stop new 1024 vectors but won't fix already-ingested 1024s (failed).
ingest-bot: INGEST-2345 created: 'acme-corp mixed-dim batch rejects' assigned to ryan, lucas; backfill-job templated as BACKFILL-718, estimated run time 4-8h for 12k docs.
ryan: patch deployed to canary at 1715123600: indexer will now detect mixed-dim batches, NACK them with a specific error code 'mixed_dim_batch' and enqueue per-vector reingest split. will monitor.
lucas: rate limiter setting relaxed for indexer for 30m to let retry flood through. watch alerts.
emma: notified customer: suggested short-term routing pin + we'll run backfill. they asked about billing adjustments for failed attempts.
priya: finance note — mark failed writes as non-billable if they never reached vecdb write committed state. we'll need intake with billing team.
ryan: reproducer steps for eng: 1) call embeddings endpoint with two models: one 1536 and one 1024 vector in same 'vectors' array; 2) send as one batch; 3) indexer logs show 'mixed_dim_batch' and NACK. curl example: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"mixed-test","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
# client-side created payload with 2 embeddings: [vec(1536), vec(1024)] -> server rejects
```
ryan: planned follow-ups: - complete indexer canary -> prod (if green) - run BACKFILL-718 to re-embed failed docs or reingest after split - coordinate with vecdb vendor on a migration plan if customer wants to permanently switch dims
vendor-sam: I'll carve out a support window to advise on backfill approach and export/import patterns.
emma: thanks. I'll update the ticket with the mitigation steps and ETA (backfill start in ~1h once patch is validated). :thumbsup:
priya: postmortem action items: (A) improve model-swap gating so clients cannot receive mixed-dim responses in a single batch, (B) add quick-detect metric for mixed-dim batch rate, (C) clarify billing policy for failed ingest attempts.
emma: assigning followups: ryan (indexer patch + backfill), lucas (rate-limit monitoring & SLO), priya (billing + routing override), vendor-sam (vecdb migration advise). will circle back after backfill run.
ingest-bot: BACKFILL-718 scheduled start 1715127000 status=scheduled
ryan: confirming prod patch deployed 1715123720. monitoring logs now.
emma: thanks everyone, keeping customer posted.
